title: Object Zonal Availability Info Added
summary: Cloud Storage objects now expose `zonalAvailabilityInfo` in their metadata, detailing their presence in Rapid Cache Ultra (RCU) zonal caches. This includes a list of `availableZones` where the object has a zonal copy.
details: The `Object` schema in the `storage.v1` API has been extended with a new top-level property, `zonalAvailabilityInfo`. This object provides details about an object's availability within Rapid Cache Ultra (RCU) zonal caches. Specifically, it includes an `availableZones` array, which lists the zones (e.g., 'us-central1-a') where a zonal copy of the object exists. This information will populate once the object is loaded into the cache, offering greater visibility into data locality for performance-sensitive applications.
